get.description: Returns stages determined by lead status. Each stage includes all bids linked to its leads, regardless of bid status, with lead_id, nullable numeric value, currency, and suppliers. A stage currency is reported only when every linked bid shares one source ISO currency; mixed or unknown currencies report null. The separate active_bids list and summary remain limited to active bids. inflight_projects contains full saved projects with status In-flight; Active, On Hold, Completed and Cancelled are excluded. Each active bid includes supplier_details from explicitly linked supplier profiles. suppliers retains legacy names plus linked profile names. Unlinked names are not converted into fabricated profiles. Apply supplier-migration.sql before deploying.

post.description: Public endpoint. Rate limited to 5 requests per hour per IP. Creates a lead record and triggers email notification.

Admin only. Requires full_name and email headers. Matching emails (case-insensitive) update existing leads using non-empty CSV fields; blank or omitted fields preserve saved values. New emails create leads. Repeated emails within the CSV are skipped after the first successful row. Returns created, updated, skipped, failed, and row errors. Optional bid_value (plain number, 0 valid, or literal null) and suppliers (semicolon-separated names or JSON array; [] clears) create/update the bid linked to the lead ID. Blank bid cells preserve existing details. Creating a bid also requires bid_phase and bid_deadline, plus bid_project/bid_client or the lead's project/company. Bid import preserves lead status and project_size. Lead and bid writes are separate; bids_failed and row errors report bid failures even when the lead was saved and HTTP status is 200. Bid validation errors identify the CSV field. bid_deadline must be a real YYYY-MM-DD date. Partial saves return HTTP 200 with success:false, partial_success:true, top-level errors (also in data.errors), and the first error in message. Full success returns success:true and partial_success:false. No-save failures return 400/409 with partial_success:false.

get.description: Exports lead fields plus bid_value, suppliers (JSON array in a CSV cell), bid_phase, bid_deadline, bid_project, and bid_client. Bids match lead_id regardless of bid status. Zero is preserved; unknown bid amount is literal null; no linked bid produces blank bid fields. Project size remains separate. Multiple linked bids export as separate rows with repeated lead fields and bid_id. bid_id is informational; imports still reject ambiguous multiple-bid links.

Returns all data needed by the lead dashboard: KPI cards, industry/application charts, stages, trends, regional coverage, and qualified leads. Regional coverage includes won_deal_value: total linked bid amounts for non-archived leads with status won, grouped by region and sorted highest first. Null amounts contribute zero. This is won deal value, not payments received; project_size is never used. Frontend should display won_deal_value as money rather than a percentage. Existing regional pipeline_value retains all linked deal amounts. Each region reports currency only when all its linked bids share one source currency; mixed or unknown currencies report null. data.leads_by_application is an array of {application, lead_count} across all non-archived leads (all lifecycle statuses). Counts each lead once per trimmed, case-insensitive application_tools name, ignores blanks, and returns [] without data. Sorted by descending count then name; display casing uses the first encountered name in lead-ID order. Existing application_distribution is preserved.

Source-currency-safe pipeline totals. Single source currencies can be formatted using currency. Mixed currencies have null scalar totals and separate pipeline_totals. No geographic inference or FX conversion. Recommended tools data is explicitly unavailable.

get.summary: Aggregate Outreach card metrics for one reporting period
get.description: Authenticated read. Completed LinkedIn steps count as sent. Response rate uses distinct contacted leads with manual replies in the same period after contact. Meetings count original bookings, including later cancellations. Unavailable metrics are null; installed tracking with no activity is zero. Missing stats schema returns 200 with null metrics and migration guidance. Unexpected failures remain errors. Standalone manual LinkedIn sends also contribute to linkedin_sent and distinct contacted leads after the LinkedIn activity migration.
